description: This file implements an OVSDB cache management module for the OneWifi project, including functions for monitoring, updating, inserting, and fetching rows in the OVSDB cache, with callback handling for database updates.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_cache_update_cb
methods.description: Callback function handling OVSDB update events, updating the cache accordingly.

methods.name: ovsdb_cache_monitor_columns
methods.description: Sets up monitoring of specific columns in an OVSDB table.

methods.name: ovsdb_cache_monitor
methods.description: Sets up monitoring of an entire OVSDB table, with option to ignore version changes.

methods.name: ovsdb_cache_monitor_filter
methods.description: Sets up filtered monitoring of an OVSDB table.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_cache_dump_table
methods.description: Prints the current cache contents of a specified OVSDB table.

methods.name: _ovsdb_cache_insert_row
methods.description: Inserts a row into the cache's data structures and logs the operation.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_cache_find_row_by_uuid
methods.description: Finds a cache row by its UUID.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_cache_find_row_by_key
methods.description: Finds a cache row by its primary key.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_cache_find_row_by_key2
methods.description: Finds a cache row by its secondary key.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_cache_find_by_uuid
methods.description: Returns the record data for a row identified by UUID.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_cache_find_by_key
methods.description: Returns the record data for a row identified by primary key.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_cache_find_by_key2
methods.description: Returns the record data for a row identified by secondary key.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_cache_get_by_uuid
methods.description: Copies the record data for a row identified by UUID into provided buffer.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_cache_get_by_key
methods.description: Copies the record data for a row identified by primary key into provided buffer.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_cache_get_by_key2
methods.description: Copies the record data for a row identified by secondary key into provided buffer.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_cache_upsert
methods.description: Inserts or updates a record in the cache and synchronizes with the OVSDB.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_cache_upsert_get_uuid
methods.description: Performs upsert and retrieves the UUID of the record.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_cache_pre_fetch
methods.description: Pre-fetches a record from the OVSDB into cache by key.
